summary: MGM Resorts International filed an 8-K reporting that its subsidiary MGM China Holdings issued $750M of 6.25% senior notes due 2033 under a new indenture. The notes were sold to accredited investors and subsequently resold under Rule 144A/Regulation S. Net proceeds of ~$739.9M will repay portions of a revolving credit facility and for general corporate purposes. Interest payable semiannually beginning November 15, 2026. The notes include make-whole redemption provisions, a 35% equity clawback, and change-of-control/put options at 101% or 100% of principal. This is a routine debt issuance, not a special situation.
